name: Necromancer audit: Corpse Commander cuts Corpse Explosion's cost by 20 Runic Power (#986)
contract: Corpse Commander 707739 (CharacterAdvancement 12381, Class tab, class 23) reads 'Reduces the Runic Power cost of Corpse Explosion by $/10;s1.' Spell.dbc: a passive whose effect 0 is aura 107 (ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER) op 14 (SPELLMOD_COST), BasePoints -201 + DieSides 1 = -200 (Runic Power is stored in tenths, so -20 Runic Power), class mask word 1 0x100 in family 29. Every Corpse Explosion rank 533236-533239 is family 29 with SpellFamilyFlags word 1 0x100, PowerType 6 (Runic Power) and ManaCost 400 (40 Runic Power). SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost applies SPELLMOD_COST natively, so the talented cost is 200 (20 Runic Power) and an untalented caster pays 400. From 100 Runic Power a real cast leaves 80 with the talent and 60 without (out-of-combat decay can remove at most one 3-point tick in the window).

steps.label: SETUP: the Corpse Commander passive is active
CONTROL: the plain caster has no Corpse Commander
CONTROL: Corpse Explosion costs 40 Runic Power
Corpse Commander makes Corpse Explosion cost 20 Runic Power
The reduction covers the highest Corpse Explosion rank
A talented Corpse Explosion spends 20 Runic Power
CONTROL: an untalented Corpse Explosion spends 40 Runic Power
